content.string: The Council-Elect is led into the Meeting by the City of London’s Sergeant-at-Arms, the London Police Service Colour Guard and the London Police Service Piper.
The National Anthem is led by Between the Keys.
Councillor-Elect M. Cassidy provides the Traditional Land Recognition.

3.title: Greetings from the Federal Members of Parliament

content.string: Ms. Irene Mathyssen M.P., brings greetings.
The Clerk acknowledges, with thanks, the communications received Federal Members of Parliament.

content.string: The Clerk acknowledges, with thanks, the communications received from Provincial Members of Parliament.

content.string: Mayor-Elect E. Holder extends appreciation to the Federal Government, Provincial Government representatives, past Municipal Council Members, and community representatives and to all in attendance.

content.string: Glen Pearson, Community Activist and former Member of Parliament invests His Worship Ed Holder with the Mayor's Chain of Office.

His Worship Mayor Ed Holder calls the meeting to order and delivers the  Inaugural Address.

pre_motion_texts.string: Pursuant to section 12.13 of the Council Procedure By-law, Councillor P. Van Meerbergen calls for a recorded vote on the motion to appoint a Deputy Mayor.
